name: Layrr
description: Rare minerals such as solid silver, gold, and platinum are essential to build key technology in a wide range of sectors from energy to aerospace. Layrr have found a way to transform how we produce rare minerals using a atomic level coating know as physical vapor desposition. Cheap material cores such as stainless steel are coated with a fine later of precious metal, giving the atom the ability to carry out the same properties as the rare material alternative. This method uses 90% less of precious materials, produces lighter alternatives, with no chemical waste or hazardous solvents.
description_alternates: LAYRR engineers materials at the atomic level to overcome thermal bottlenecks limiting modern industries like data centres and EVs. By applying ultra-thin nano-coatings to commodity powders, the company transforms them into high-performance metamaterials with significantly improved thermal conductivity. This enables cooler chips, lighter components, and more efficient systems, while dramatically reducing material development time from years to weeks and allowing the same upgraded material to be used across multiple manufacturing formats. Investors AgFunder

description: LendUp is a socially responsible company on a mission to redefine… Could a fintech company be built that helps people today, and prepares them for tomorrow? One that offers consumers high quality, mobile-first credit and savings products and protects them from tricks and traps? That’s LendUp. LendUp's mission is to provide anyone with a better path to financial health. We believe there are two types of financial products: chutes and ladders. One of our values is "different backgrounds, same mission."​ We come from venerable Silicon Valley technology companies, major banks, nonprofits and law firms. description: AI-powered Remote Cardiovascular Diagnostics One in two people over age 65 have an undiagnosed heart valve disease. name: Lithosquare
description: Lithosquare is accelerating critical minerals discovery with AI-driven geological intelligence that addresses the global supply bottleneck. The Paris-based company helps mining companies identify, rank and advance high-potential copper, lithium and rare earth deposits, faster, with higher confidence and at a fraction of the traditional cost. What sets Lithosquare apart is its geology-first approach. Where most AI-exploration tools look for statistical patterns in historical data, Lithosquare reasons from the science of how deposits form. Its platform is built around a proprietary metallogeny ontology covering around 20 deposit types, developed and maintained by PhD metallogenists working alongside AI engineers. This allows the system to generate credible targets in greenfield areas where no historical training data exists, a capability that pattern matching approaches cannot replicate. Why we invested in Lithosquare The climate case: Only around 1 in 1,000 mineral exploration projects ever becomes a mine, yet global demand for copper, lithium and rare earths is accelerating as electrification and AI infrastructure intensify. Average mine development lead times have stretched to nearly 18 years, creating a critical gap between exploration decisions today and production needed in the 2030s and 2040s. Lithosquare directly addresses this bottleneck by accelerating high-confidence discovery in jurisdictions that can meet Western supply-chain resilience requirements. By bringing new reserves to market faster and from jurisdictions with stronger environmental standards, Lithosquare unblocks the materials supply that global electrification depends on. The business case: Global mineral exploration budgets have historically ranged between $12-15bn annually, with a portion allocated to target generation, data analytics and technical advisory. Lithosquare's asset-light, partnership-driven model captures exploration service revenues while retaining long-term economic upside through Net Smelter Return royalties on successful discoveries. The global royalty and streaming sector has a combined enterprise value of over $140bn. Early partnerships validate strong demand for AI-accelerated exploration workflows and demonstrate traction across both large-cap operators and mid-tier explorers. The team: Co-Founder and CEO Aymeric Preveral-Etcheverry previously scaled Fieldbox, an industrial AI company. COO Simon Leclair brings 15+ years of mining expertise, including early-career mine development work at Eramet and 8 years as a partner at BCG specialising in Metals and Mining strategy. Both are Mines Paris graduates, combining deep geological credibility with proven operational execution and AI expertise. name: LiveU
description: LiveU is driving the live video revolution, providing live video streaming for TV, mobile, online and social media. LiveU makes it possible for audiences to become part of the story, with high-quality and flawless live video transmitted from anywhere in the world, through the use of patented bonding and video transport technology. LiveU creates a consistent bandwidth and a reliable connection that enables the acquisition, management and distribution of high quality remote live broadcasts over IP. The company’s broad portfolio of products sets the industry standard for live video production. From backpacks to smartphones, and satellite/cellular hybrid to external antenna solutions, LiveU offers a complete range of devices for live video coverage anytime, anywhere. In addition, LiveU offers extensive cloud-based management and video distribution solutions. With over 2,000 customers in 80+ countries, LiveU’s technology is the solution of choice for global broadcasters, online media, news agencies and social media. Providing high quality live video solutions for TV, mobile, online and social media

Its technology has powered coverage of major breaking news and global events, including the U.S. Presidential Campaign, the London Olympics, Hurricane Sandy, the Royal Wedding, the GRAMMY Awards, and the Super Bowl. LiveU’s solutions combine multiple 4G/3G, HSPA+, WiMAX, and Wi-Fi links to deliver maximum video quality and reliability. A leader in live video over cellular technology, LiveU was acquired by Francisco Partners and Israel Growth Partners.

name: Lockin Company
description: Lockin Company's mobile app security solution LIAPP is a no-code SaaS security service that applies protection simply by uploading a completed app, with no additional coding required. It has gained popularity by offering annual and monthly subscription plans, allowing users to purchase and use the product according to their preferred billing period. LIAPP is a Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) solution that provides robust security for mobile apps, alerting security teams and users to threats detected outside the system to prevent attacks. It offers a wide range of cybersecurity services including rooting and jailbreak detection, debugging and tampering prevention, in-app memory and native library protection, as well as remote control blocking and screen capture prevention to effectively guard against fraud in the financial sector. App administrators can also monitor threats in real time via a dashboard, enabling companies running mobile app services to effectively defend against app hacking. Founded in 2013, Lockin Company is a cybersecurity services specialist whose LIAPP solution is widely used across Korea, Japan, the United States, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Austria, and Brazil. Notably, Lockin Company has been recognized by Gartner as a representative application security vendor and was designated as an 'Outstanding Information Security Technology Product' by the Ministry of Science and ICT. name: Lofty
description: Building the NASDAQ for Real Estate. Lofty is a marketplace that let's anyone sell a house to investors online. Instead of the typical real estate transaction where one seller sells to one buyer, Lofty is much more flexible. Sellers fractionalize their equity ownership in the property into smaller units, so that anyone can buy a portion for as little as $50, allowing access to one of the best asset classes for people who have previously been locked out. Investors truly legally own the properties they invested in and co-manage it with other investors through an online governance program. Owners have so far voted on how to handle various repairs, delinquent tenants, the sale of the underlying property, and much more. Lofty never custodies or handles user funds or assets. Through smart-contracts on the blockchain, all transactions are directly peer-to-peer. name: Lokalise
description: Petr Antropov and Nick Ustinov founded Lokalise in Riga, Latvia, in 2017 after running into the localisation problem first-hand. While building a mobile app that grew past a million users across multiple language markets, they found that existing translation management tools were slow, lacked context, and required tedious manual work. Ustinov, a self-taught developer, built a custom tool to automate translation and maintain context within the app. It proved to be a product with demand well beyond their own needs. Lokalise has since evolved beyond a traditional translation management system into a full localization platform combining AI orchestration, human translation, and workflow automation. The platform automatically selects between multiple AI engines based on context, language pair and content type, while integrating with over 60 tools including GitHub, GitLab, Figma, Contentful and Zendesk. Teams across product, engineering, design, marketing and localisation use it to translate apps, websites, games and marketing content with continuous localisation baked into their existing workflows. The company now serves over 3,000 organisations worldwide, including Mastercard, Toyota, HP, Revolut, Notion and Yelp
description_alternates: Localization and translation software
Lokalise is the most loved and trusted localization tool – partnering with over 3,000 companies globally across product, engineering, marketing, content and design teams.
A translation management system built for agile teams who want to automate their localization process.

Lokalise is the leading localization and translation management platform for agile teams. It embraces automation, workflow transparency, and fast project delivery. In their own words, "Lokalise is on a mission to eliminate the hassle of localization - the process of adapting and translating digital content to local markets - by providing a platform to automate, integrate, and better manage translations of digital content into multiple languages: because localisation removes borders and leads to more growth." We are proud and excited to partner up with the Lokalise team in making localization effortless in a strong setup with Chalfen Ventures by the experienced B2B software investor Mike Chalfen and high-profile angel investors including Andrey Khusid (Founder and CEO of Miro ), Nicolas Dessaigne (Co-Founder of Algolia ) and Des Traynor (Co-Founder and CSO of Intercom ).

description: Lorefully is an AI-powered knowledge engine that captures unstructured data from fragmented silos within communities to surface the value held within. By enabling people to learn from each other in real-time, Lorefully reduces the need to relearn what others already know. This unlocks a faster, more efficient path to action—particularly vital in high-stakes areas like the clean energy transition or complex infrastructure delivery. name: Lucy
description: Lucy’s mission is to reduce tobacco-related harm to zero. We provide… If it isn’t bad enough that smokers don’t realize the scientific facts about nicotine, most non-tobacco nicotine products are poorly designed and unappealing to use. The leading gum is sold like a pharmaceutical drug, with flavoring and packaging to match. Vapes provide a cumbersome, over-the-top experience — with use as tightly restricted as cigarette smoking itself, but more juvenile, conspicuous, and highly addictive. People want, and deserve, a better way. Therefore, we want to deliver nicotine users a superior experience, and at the same time give them a way to transition out of feeling dependent. In a better society, people wouldn’t carry around the sensation that they’re stuck with an involuntary habit. Our mission isn’t to encourage nicotine use among people who haven’t started. Unlike certain vapes or other products, ours isn’t the sort coveted by underage users on social media. Our mission is to alleviate the harm related to tobacco — first and foremost, by switching people away from the most harmful products. So, at Lucy, we take an evidence based view of nicotine. Nicotine’s pleasurable properties make it an inevitable part of modern society. Therefore, minimizing harm in all nicotine products is key, in addition to giving people products and strategies for cessation. We feel that, as 1,300 people are dying of tobacco related illnesses every day in the US, the most important and immediate step toward a better society is giving nicotine consumers products they enjoy using that will cause less harm. Our first product is designed to appeal to smokers and encourage them to switch. And, looking ahead, we hope to secure approval in the future as a clinically proven smoking cessation aid, while continuing to participate in the FDA’s public hearings around how NRTs are best regulated. Our goals are simple: because harm reduction is a better strategy around nicotine delivery than abstinence or prohibition, we want to help improve public health — and reduce its costs — through a superior pure nicotine product.

name: Lumius
description: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable. We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.

name: Lura Health
description: Integrated continual health-monitoring platform Americans and humans globally are facing multiple health crises, as they are plagued by chronic disease, which require consistent tracking in order to provide effective treatment. Generation of continuous data for monitoring and controlling these diseases is essential, as single-point tests do not effectively measure long-term trends, cannot provide early, proactive alerts, and do not enable measurements of efficacy of preventative measures. The world is calling for a non-invasive medical wearable to address these challenges, and salivary diagnostics have emerged as an exciting solution, and are now approaching a growth inflection point. In order to bring this promising approach to continuous, real-time monitoring to life, Lura Health has solved a monumental engineering challenge and developed the world’s first salivary diagnostic wearable. To achieve this breakthrough, the team invented 5 custom components and leveraged latest pre-market advances from top companies, and they developed microscale assembly processes to fit full IoT system on a tooth. This technology can be easily integrated into existing devices, such as retainers, implants, and dentures. Lura’s sensors are implemented in the mouth, providing real-time, continuous data that is sent to a patient’s smart phone, and shared with their doctor. Their first go-to-market opportunity is within dental applications, where the sensor will be used to monitor acid as an warning sign for tooth decay. They are also pursuing medical applications, starting with glucose monitoring for diabetes and electrolyte monitoring for chronic kidney and cardiovascular disease.

name: Manta Aircraft
description: Regional Aviation Rethought! As a part of the emerging industry of Advanced and Regional Air Mobility, Manta Aircraft is developing an innovative and evolutive long-range eV/STOL air mobility platform to tackle 2 markets: > The one of the HELICOPTERS, existing and well known down to the details. We offer a very convenient alternative to helicopters, allowing "backgarden-to-backgarden" travel and a new type of flight services for private/public > and DEFENSE sectors in the urban and regional airspace. The vehicles are responding to real needs of specific industries, are designed for the roles of surveillance, rapid intervention (eg. disaster/emergency response), transportation of specialty material and persons, in the civil and defence environments - and are ready to evolve to new markets performing new types of missions. Key points of the programme: > eV/STOL: Vertical and Short Take-Off and Landing. The short take off option offers to triplicate the range > Long ranges 200-500+ miles (300-800+ km) at high speed 155-186mph (250 - 300 km/h), making it the eV/STOL combination with the longest range > Development of a platform as the base to generate multiple models (2-Seater, 4-Seater, 6-Seater, Cargo-Version, Unmanned/UAV) > Highly adaptable and reconfigurable for several different missions > A fraction of the operating costs of a comparable helicopter > Go-to-market strategy staggered in alignment with the certification steps, for a quicker ROI > An extremely experienced and qualified team, which accomplished more than 20 aircraft certifications (airplanes & helicopters): https://www.mantaaircraft.com/team > Scalability: easy global deployment, versioning for a wide range of use cases, aftermarket and technology revenues beyond aircraft sales. Regarding Manta's USP and differentiation in the market, I would like to highlight three key attributes: > Design - Optimised for vertical flight and for cruise as there are 4 propellers in the fuselage optimized for the vertical flight and 4 in the wings optimzed for cruise; > Hybrid Propulsion System - the turbo-generator allows the aircraft to cover long distances at high speed, whilst avoiding the need for special ground infrastructure like runways or for battery recharging stations, while the battery provides the energy to cover peak demanding situations like the vertical take off and landing > Modularity - Same subsystems used across multiple models, thus minimizing the cost of versioning, maximizing synergies and allowing for scaling up quickly as the aircraft could be assembled in several locations globally. The performance combination of Manta Aircraft provides executive advantages over helicopters, eVTOL air taxis, airplanes and drones. The accurate/verified design, the use of existing technology and off the shelf solutions where possible, the platform approach and the creation of assets along the development process are elements that de-risk the project.

name: Maritime Fusion
description: Fusion reactors for ships Maritime Fusion is building fusion reactors for ships and off grid energy markets. En route on this endeavor we’re commercializing High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) cable technology for power distribution while advancing the physics basis of our HTS tokamak to decarbonize global shipping. Breakeven fusion is coming soon, but the first-of-a-kind (FOAK) reactors will be costly, high maintenance, and have low capacity factors, leading to 5–10x higher electricity cost on the grid. Maritime Fusion is pursuing the most widely accepted approach to fusion, the tokamak, but specifically designed for the marine environment where the challenges that arise between breakeven and a commercially viable energy source are alleviated. The market we're targeting requires 15x less power, lower up-time, and costs the same as alternative fuels but without any emissions. Since fusion does not use highly radioactive fuels or materials – unlike fission – we sidestep the vast majority of regulatory challenges and safety risks associated with nuclear energy. Our team brings over a decade of industry and research experience in plasma physics, nuclear engineering, and electrical engineering with backgrounds at SpaceX, Tesla, Columbia University, and University of Pennsylvania.
description_alternates: Maritime Fusion is building the first nuclear fusion reactors for marine applications, using compact high-temperature superconducting technology to power shipping vessels. name: Masterpiece
description: Working capital for data companies training frontier AI We believe AI will be one of humanity’s next great masterpieces. Building it will require financial infrastructure as ambitious as the companies creating it. We're founders backed by Y Combinator building the financial rails underpinning the AI data economy. Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs. A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. This creates a 30 to 90 day cash gap between when vendors incur costs and when they receive payment. Legacy invoice lenders have little visibility into how to underwrite these assets. Masterpiece closes that gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. Vendors can use the capital to scale delivery, pay contributors, and fund growth, then repay masterpiece when the lab payment arrives.

name: Mayan Finance
description: Mayan Finance is a cross chain auctions protocol built on Solana and Wormhole. They allow users to move assets between major EVM chains and Solana quickly and with minimal price impact. What distinguishes Mayan from other swapping protocols is that they don’t just rely on liquidity pools to change between assets. This can lead to large, unexpected slippage and churns users. Mayan holds auctions, where market makers and other protocols can bid on the order flow in a transparent, competitive process. This results in deeper liquidity for users and better execution prices. By building on Solana, Mayan is able to conduct these auctions entirely on chain (while their competitors build this off-chain), which increases trust, and transparency.

name: Mediachain
description: The goal of Mine is to make metadata for digital images persistent and discoverable anywhere images exist. Today, information about an image, such as authorship or context, is quickly lost as it is shared across the internet. An image may start its life illustrating a news article on the New York Times, annotated with the photographers name and an insightful caption, but it quickly gets stripped down of any valuable context as it propagates different channels of the internet. We effectively know less about an image as it goes viral and reaches more people Mine wants to leverage the phenomenon of social image sharing in the production of a visual knowledge project. Mine uses computer vision to connect the thousands of different appearances of an image, over a thousand contexts and across any platform into one source image: where everything about that image can be collected and known. The entire ripple an image makes across the world is shown under one heading and the Mine community filters what information is most important. Our goal is to disinter mediate media consumption and interaction, which today relies on centralized platforms such as Facebook and Twitter which monetize their users and all the content that flows through them with little benefit to the communities that create that value. This is why we are building our dataset on top of the blockchain, the same technology that enabled two people to exchange a financial asset with no middleman in the case of Bitcoin. We have specified a proposal for our open dataset in the Canonical Content Registry: https://github.com/mine-code/canonical-content-registry

name: Medisafe
description: Medisafe empowers patients to stay on top of all their medications through a digital patient engagement platform. Its approach leverages the billions of data points collected to personalize patient engagement and improve adherence and persistence to medications. By addressing the major challenges of medication management utilizing a datascience-driven approach, Medisafe improves patient adherence and quality of care. The company provides its pharma and payer partners the opportunity to engage each patient on an individual level, supporting them throughout the entire patient journey, and provides unique insights on behavior patterns critical for improving the patient experience. Medisafe had shown over numerous studies, both retrospective with tens of thousands of patients as well as RCTs, that its solutions improve adherence by up to 20%. Founded following an accidental insulin overdose of the founders' father, the Medisafe solution currently has over 7m users, who have recorded over 2 billion medication doses. Nearly 200,000 users have rated the app an average of 4.7 out of 5 stars in the App Store and Google Play store, making it the Top Rated solution in the category. Their accolades include Gartner Cool Vendors, Traction winner (Health 2.0 startup competition), Fast Company Most Innovative in Healthcare, Google and Apple Editors' Choice and Top Developer.
description_alternates: Medisafe is the personalized medication management platform addressing all major causes of non-adherence. Medisafe’s cloud-based mobile platform personalizes content, resources and interventions — such as educational videos, coupons and motivational messages — based on each user's regimen, condition and specific circumstance. Medisafe fosters collaboration between patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals through caregiver tools and reports, and helps the care continuum improve health outcomes and sustain quality care initiatives.
Empowering patients to seamlessly manage their medications

Medisafe is the leading AI-driven digital patient engagement company, empowering patients to manage their treatment journey and overall health while providing real-time intelligence from billions of data points. By combining advanced technology and a suite of AI-driven solutions with behavioral science, Medisafe supports patients, providers, and payers at scale to improve engagement, health management, and outcomes. More than 13 million registered patients and caregivers rely on Medisafe’s HIPAA- and GDPR-compliant platform, which is also ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 13485 certified.

Medisafe™ is a leading mobile medication management platform that reminds patients to take their medications via smartphones and tablets, serving to improve medication adherence rates and curb the growing annual health care costs globally.

name: Memoir
description: Everything your team ships, explained to everyone it affects. Memoir is building a persistent and proactive AI teammate that helps an entire company keep up with its own progress. Think Instinct but for enterprise. We’re starting with product changes. When engineering ships something, Memoir understands who it affects and creates what each audience needs: a walkthrough for a customer, launch materials for a product marketer, or a technical explanation for another engineering team. It chooses the format and timing, then delivers the approved material in Slack. Nobody has to ask it to start. We’re beginning with hands-on deployments, learning how each company works and where people depend on one another. That understanding will let Memoir expand beyond product releases to customer commitments, business decisions, and changes across departments. The idea grew from conversations with product marketers struggling to keep up with engineering, and the possibility of extending a proactive personal AI teammate to an entire business. Our ambition is a company where every important change sets the right communication in motion: the people affected receive something made for them, when they need it, without someone having to coordinate every handoff. As AI makes individual teams faster, Memoir helps that speed carry through the whole company.

name: Metabolic Psychiatry Labs
description: M etabolic Psychiatry Labs treats serious mental illness through metabolism. People with conditions like bipolar disorder, major depression and schizophrenia often also struggle with obesity, insulin resistance and other metabolic problems, and each condition makes the other worse. Standard care treats the two separately, and psychiatric medication alone often has limited effect. The company runs a remote care program that combines psychiatric treatment with personalized metabolic interventions: diet, including ketogenic approaches, supplements and medication adjustments. Patients are monitored through an app that tracks lab results, glucose and ketone levels and mental health measures, and the data guides each person’s treatment. The company was founded by Dr. Shebani Sethi, who pioneered the field of metabolic psychiatry at Stanford, and is based in Menlo Park, California.
description_alternates: Metabolism-driven mental health care, personalized and remote Metabolic Psychiatry Labs delivers integrated mental health care that targets root metabolic drivers like insulin resistance, inflammation, and nutrition. Patients use connected at-home devices and a secure mobile app for daily mood, sleep, and energy tracking, plus coordinated remote lab testing and video visits. Board-certified psychiatric and metabolic specialists personalize treatment plans that combine medication management, nutrition interventions, and ongoing monitoring.

description: H eadquartered in San Francisco, Metabolize is building a new category of precision metabolite products for weight management. GLP-1 drugs have changed how people lose weight, but most patients stop treatment at some point because of cost, side effects or access, and most of the weight comes back. There is no clear standard of care for this phase, and as GLP-1 use keeps growing, more people are reaching it every year. The company’s first product, NatLean, is a dietary supplement designed to help people keep the weight off after stopping GLP-1 therapy. It is based on metabolites the body already produces, which regulate appetite and metabolism through pathways different from GLP-1.

name: Metastable Materials
description: Metastable Materials is a deep tech company pioneering a low-cost, clean and highly scalable method of recycling lithium-ion batteries. Their mission is to power the circular supply chain for a sustainable tomorrow. Lithium-ion battery recycling, which today is a US$4.6 billion industry, is expected to grow at least five times by 2030. Natural reserves of the metals that go into EV batteries are finite, and as EV adoption continues to accelerate so will the demand for raw and recycled materials. Many nations – including the EU – plan to introduce regulations to ensure that batteries can be repurposed or recycled at the end of their life. Current recycling methods face poor unit economics, scalability issues and unsustainable supply chain practices. Metastable has developed the world’s first, chemical-free Integrated Carbothermal Reduction™ process for recycling and extracting valuable materials from lithium-ion batteries. This includes environmentally-friendly metal extraction technology, as well as storage and transportation solutions to safely move used batteries from consumers to recycling facilities. The end-to-end solution will unlock the potential for any city to create a sustainable supply of lithium and other critical metals. Metastable Materials was founded in October 2021 in Bengaluru by Manikumar Uppala, Saurav Goyal and Shubham Vishvakarma, who have known each other since their time at Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee. description: Consumer debt in America has reached staggering proportions. name: Metriport
description: Healthcare data infrastructure for next generation care delivery. Metriport provides real-time access to medical data for 340 million individuals across the US. Its open-source platform turns scattered patient records across all major healthcare IT systems into structured information that gives clinicians what they need, exactly when they need it, to provide the best possible care. Metriport manages dozens of connections across all national HIEs and QHINs, state and regional HIEs, ADT networks, pharmacies, labs, and EHRs. In addition to providing longitudinal patient clinical data at the point of care, Metriport offers ambient monitoring, alerting providers in real time as patients are moved through the healthcare system to assist with transitions of care. Metriport also delivers insights on top of the data, like AI medical record summarization, condition suspecting, and surfacing care gaps. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, Metriport processes 4.2 billion network requests a month and returns the first structured record in under 15 seconds. name: Mezmo
description: Observability platform to control all of your log data Mezmo, formerly LogDNA, is an observability platform to manage and take action on your data. It ingests, processes, and routes log data to fuel enterprise-level application development and delivery, security, and compliance use cases. Mezmo was brought to life by three-time co-founders Chris Nguyen and Lee Liu and included in the Winter 2015 batch of Y Combinator. In 2018 the company partnered with tech giant, IBM, to become the sole logging provider for IBM Cloud. Mezmo is on a mission to empower people who build solutions that shape the world. We’re doing this by delivering a platform that enables enterprises to get more value from their observability data in real time, regardless of source, destination, use case, or scale. We’re not the only ones working on this problem but we have a few things the others don’t. We’re cloud-native and know how to make the most of modern technology like Kubernetes. We have scaled a solution from zero to petabyte scale in a short amount of time, while supporting thousands of active users across multiple environments. We are hungry for change and are surrounded by enterprises telling us they’re hungry, too. We have a kick-ass group of people who are thinking about the problem analytically and are excited to change the observability world for the better. Mezmo has helped some of the world’s most innovative companies transform how they manage their systems and applications. Still, we know that we can help them get more value from their observability data by providing more flexibility and control over how they use it. This will enable teams to spend less time switching between data silos so they can focus on shipping better, more resilient, and secure products. We have momentum on our side. Last year we saw triple digit revenue growth and added 800 new customers to our roster. Recent accolades include being named to YC’s Top Companies, CRN’s 10 Hottest DevOps Startups, and EMA’s Top 3 Observability Platforms.

description: 3D printing beautiful, high-quality, and sustainable homes. Mighty Buildings is an innovative construction technology company based in Oakland, CA creating beautiful, sustainable, and high-quality homes using 3d-printing, robotics, and automation. Their mission is to have a positive impact on the environment, local communities, and the housing crisis through their sustainable approach. Mighty Buildings' technology has the potential to unlock the needed productivity for large scale construction alongside the opportunity for reduced emissions, leading to a more sustainable product and future. Mighty Buildings was founded by a team of physicists and robotics engineers with extensive experience solving hard R&D problems and building successful engineering firms. They started by inventing a new material that is a 3D printing tech that enabled printing of an entire building, not just walls, in a single cycle. Unlike concrete, Mighty Buildings’ material is lighter, can be uniquely treated (trimmed and cut) by robotic arms, and features high thermal insulation properties. This allows them to produce prefab housing with up to 80% of operations automated. Mighty Buildings has a near-zero waste production process, preventing 1,100 - 2,000 kg of CO2 emission per 3D-printed home. They are committed to achieving Net-Zero by 2028 - making the company 22 years ahead of the construction industry. The company is certified under California's Factory Built Housing program to build units using 3D-printing, but they are also the first company to achieve certification under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies.

name: MIMiC Systems
description: Solid-state heating and cooling systems at a building scale Heating and cooling make up the majority of energy consumption in buildings, representing over 40% of energy-related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Originating from extensive multidisciplinary research at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, MIMiC Systems is pioneering a technology aimed at reducing the emissions from refrigerants in traditional vapor-compression systems, while enhancing thermal comfort without incurring energy penalties. MIMiC employs advanced solid-state heat pumps, known as thermoelectric devices, combined with innovations in power electronics and controls. This approach not only boosts system efficiency but also fully eliminates the need for environmentally harmful refrigerants. The technology is particularly advantageous for retrofitting residential buildings, streamlining the installation process to save both time and labor costs. Moreover, by significantly reducing the number of moving parts, MIMiC’s solution extends the operational lifetime of heating and cooling systems, marking a significant step forward in reducing the environmental impact of building climate control.

name: Mindgrove Technologies
description: Mindgrove designs cost-effective and scalable microprocessor technology in India for the global semiconductor market. The company designs System-on-Chips (SoCs), which are integrated circuits that combine all the elements of an electronic device onto a single chip instead of separate components. Semiconductors are used in nearly every industry, from healthcare and communications to transportation and military systems, as well as clean energy. It’s a market that is expected to become a trillion-dollar industry by 2030. While the semiconductor industry has grown in the last two decades, the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the importance of these semiconductors more than ever before – a supply crunch in semiconductor production drove massive delays across nearly all manufacturing industries, from cars to computers. SoCs typically require a lot of power to perform well in devices. Mindgrove’s SoCs offer high performance with low power, making the chips ideal for use in applications where power usage may be constrained, such as consumer electronics and aviation. The company’s chips are based on Shakti, a core microprocessor that is among India’s first industrial-grade microprocessors. Mindgrove was born out of a collaboration between the government, academia, and the startup industry at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras. name: Minro
description: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale. Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly. Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email. We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time. The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.

The broader positioning is a “trust layer” for autonomous AI: infrastructure that helps developers and enterprises reduce hallucinations, bias, and single-model failure risk when deploying AI systems in higher-stakes environments.

name: Mission Zero Technologies
description: MISSION ZERO DEVELOPS A VERSATILE, SCALABLE DIRECT AIR CAPTURE SOLUTION (DAC) FOR GLOBAL APPLICATION. Mission Zero offers a modular electrochemical DAC solution powered by renewable electricity and built by off-the-shelf technology to deliver carbon removal at scale. Why we invested: The climate case : DAC is essential for achieving our global net-zero targets. According to the IPCC , up to 10 gigatonnes of CO2 must be removed from the atmosphere annually by 2050. DAC will enable the reversal of the temporary overshoot from historical emissions and emissions from hard-to-abate industries. The business case : Mission Zero's electrochemical DAC system is primed to overcome the current bottlenecks of affordability and scalability through significant energy savings, increased process efficiency, and a modular scale-up approach. The company is expected to achieve market-leading CO2 prices at a capacity of 1,000 tonnes of CO2 per year, facilitating a commercially feasible scale-up roadmap. The team : Mission Zero’s CEO, Nicholas Chadwick, is a Ph.D.-trained chemist and materials scientist with extensive experience in scaling hardware technologies. COO, Shiladity Ghosh, began his career in academia, earning a Ph.D. in chemical engineering at Imperial College London, and holds an additional MBA. CTO, Gaël Gobaille-Shaw, is a Ph.D.-trained electrochemist experienced in establishing world-leading IP strategies. name: Mitico
description: Mitigate the impact industrial carbon emissions have on people and the environment Many legacy industries present large challenges to decarbonize, and at the same time are needed to fulfill global energy demands in the short term. These include natural-gas and wood fired burners and gas-fired power plants. Existing carbon-capture media, such as amine-based sorbents, face challenges to effectively sequester carbon dioxide emitted from these heavy industrial uses. Mitico offers state-of-the-art services and equipment to capture carbon dioxide (CO2). Their patent-pending granulated metal carbonate sorption technology (GMC), developed at Caltech, captures over 95% of the CO2 emitted from post-combustion point sources (flue gases), including gas-fired power plants and boilers, and waste-to-energy and biomass-to-energy facilities. They enable carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) as a service at a low cost, reachig prices below $50/ton. The Mitico technology is based on using abundant, cost-effective, and low-impact GMC sorbents. The GMC solid can be rejuvenated through moderate temperature- and pressure-driven swing sorption-desorption cycles. The extracted and purified (99.9%) CO2 can be sequestered or used as a feedstock for green chemistry. The Mitico process is scalable, applicable to small (1K CO2 tonne/year) natural-gas and wood fired burners all the way to large (>100K CO2 tonne /year) gas-fired power plants and hard-to-decarbonize industries.
description_alternates: Mitico is developing an integrated point-source carbon capture solution for industrial emitters
Granulated metal carbonate sorption captures CO2 from power plant flue gases for retrofit installation
Mitico provides an affordable, simple and safe carbon capture technology, helping industrial emitters cut their carbon emissions by over 95%.
Mitico delivers a solution for carbon capture using dry granular metal carbonate (GMC) purification technology with integrated measurement, reporting, and verification.

description: Production infrastructure on autopilot You built your product in a weekend and deployed to Vercel, Supabase, Railway or AWS. Monarch is a mission-driven company aiming to elevate farming practices to enable clean, efficient and economically viable solutions for farmers. name: Moonshot
description: agents for the rest of us We want to bring AI agents to a billion people. To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector. Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life. For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot. Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable. Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf. Take life personally. The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail. Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team. Let's make it a Moonshot.

name: Moss
description: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural. If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs. Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. name: Mount
description: The AI Agent Insurance Carrier TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them. Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more. Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems. Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage. Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.

name: Multifactor
description: Zero-trust authentication, authorization, and auditing for AI agents The agentic era is here, but its foundation is dangerously insecure. A growing number of high-profile "AI agent gone rogue" security incidents make headlines each week. As enterprise adoption of agentic software has far outpaced the development of applicable cybersecurity solutions, CISOs have loudly voiced a growing need for verifiable, fine-grained security controls on complex multi-agent systems. That's why we built Multifactor. Multifactor offers best-in-class authentication, authorization, and auditing technologies for agentic systems, allowing users to securely and revocably share online accounts with agents while maintaining fine-grained permissions and a detailed event history. We are doing for AI security what Cloudflare did for web security, Okta did for identity security, and Wiz did for cloud security: defining the category. A world-class "account manager" that allows agents to securely use online accounts on your behalf is just the start—our early enterprise partners include companies using AI agents to manage $7.5+ billion manufacturing supply chains, where the consequences for lapses in security are severe. Our patented AI security technology seamlessly integrates with existing agentic software to thwart attacks like prompt injection, so CISOs and end users alike can breathe a sigh of relief, without slowing the pace of AI adoption.

description: Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates Low Earth Orbit ("LEO") satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data to a diverse customer set. Muon's integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation performance. Today’s satellite constellations gather data in limited modalities and are lacking in granularity and quality, creating an information gap for both industry and government. Climate data from space

Muon designs, builds and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations that equip commercial and government customers with critical Earth intelligence. Its differentiation stems from its full-service solution (vs. simply selling a satellite bus) and its vertically integrated technology stack. From detecting wildfires and measuring greenhouse gas emissions to tracking deforestation and ocean temperatures, Muon’s technology provides the visibility we need to take meaningful climate action.

Muon Space’s small-satellites focus on dense, scientific-grade measurements of the atmosphere, ocean, and land processes related to climate. They offer the world’s first integrated remote sensing platform to bring these capabilities to organizations that lack the expertise or resources to develop them independently.

Muon Space builds and operates full-stack satellite systems that deliver mission-grade Earth-observation data to organizations without space expertise. From wildfire detection to climate resilience, Muon designs, launches, and manages custom satellite constellations end-to-end, turning raw orbital sensing into actionable planetary intelligence.

Muon Space is an end-to-end space systems company that designs, builds, and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations to deliver critical data and enable real-time compute and decision-making in space.

Muon Space builds, deploys, and operates turnkey satellite systems powering the accelerating $100B+ space infrastructure transition to LEO constellations and unlocking new use cases and markets in Climate and National Security. Founded by industry pioneers, Muon has built the industry’s best team and developed a modular, vertically integrated simulation, satellite, instrument and data IP stack.
Muon Space designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations, delivering mission-critical Earth data for climate, security, and more, making space smarter and our world safer.

name: Mux
description: Video infrastructure for developers Mux is an API-first video platform designed by experts to make world-class video streaming and analytics possible for every development team. Self-optimizing videos take the guesswork out of encodings, delivery, and renditions. Mux makes your video look beautiful on every device, every time. We offer two products, Mux Video and Mux Data. Mux Data is a Quality of Experience analytics platform that measures the performance metrics that actually matter to viewers: rebuffering, startup time, video quality, and errors. Our intuitive dashboard quickly gives users the insight to find issues and make improvements through features like A/B testing, industry-wide scores, alerts, and detailed information about every single video view. The product works out of the box on HTML5, iOS, Android, and major OTT platforms. All data is available via exports and APIs, making it easy to integrate Mux Data into other systems.

name: MyPetrolPump
description: On demand fuel delivery service in India Why did we pick this idea to work on? India is a country with 200 mln vehicles (about the same number as USA) but one third the number of gas stations(60K) as compare to USA(160K), The consequence of odd number of fuel stations is long queues of vehicles at the gas stations to fill up, heavily congested Indian roads make it worse. Opening of 100K new fuel stations is practically & economically impossible in urban localities due to rocketing high land prices. And that's how the idea of mobile refueling was conceptualized by founders. Literally "bringing the gas stations to doorsteps". The problem of buying fuel is much more alarming in large volume consumer segments such as Vehicle fleet users like schools, cab rentals, freight logistics operators , tours and travels operators, hospitals, hotels, real estate etc who burn huge amount of dead mileage & loss of productivity while sending all fleet vehicles to gas stations to fill up. Additionally, India has a unique problem of Electricity blackouts. Current avg. is less than 18 hours of a day of electricity in Indian metro cities, which causes more than 20 mln household and commercial buildings running on backup generators which require Diesel. They cant bring the generators to gas stations either therefore they buy Diesel in jerry cans or barrels and transport unsafely. Our solution is solving the desperate & daily need of Indian consumers along with convenience. Do we have domain expertise in this area? Founder is ex veteran of Shell with 9 years of global experience, has complete understanding Oil marketing business. How do you know people need what you're making? We have over 5000 registred large volume customers who are waiting to be served. With our limited number of refueling vehicles ,we could serve max 1200 customers currently. We got all these customers without spending a penny in marketing and promotion. Zero sales efforts. Additionally, we have received over 400 franchisee requests across India where people want to offer mobile refueling service their town validating the demand.

name: N.Thing
description: Founded in January 2014, N.Thing is a global agri-food tech startup driving innovation in the agricultural food sector and food value chain by integrating IT and data. It leads the agri-food tech market through the power of IT and data, with the further ambition of transforming the global food value chain. N.Thing unveiled the world's first modular smart farm 'CUBE,' built on IoT and cloud computing technology, enabling organic interconnection between units. The standardized farm 'CUBE' allows additional modules to be continuously added once a single unit's production testing is complete. N.Thing has also independently secured all essential operational technologies and developed a dedicated management system to provide crop-optimized environments for water, nutrients, temperature, light, and air. Its higher production efficiency compared to open-field cultivation makes it well-suited for large-scale supply, and its business model enables mass production of high-quality crops year-round, anywhere in the world regardless of climate — offering strong export potential. On the strength of this technology, N.Thing won the 'Best Innovation Award' in the Smart City category at 'CES 2020,' the world's largest consumer electronics and IT expo, and received the Innovation Award in the 'Sustainability, Eco-Design & Smart Energy' category at CES 2022. It currently operates smart farms in Yongin, Icheon, Andong, and Abu Dhabi in the UAE. Last year, it opened 'Sikmulseong Dosan,' an indoor vertical farm showroom. The Icheon farm, which began operations in April 2022, has started supplying produce to E-Mart, a major Korean retailer, with plans to supply over 100 tons of leafy crops annually. Additionally, in August 2022, N.Thing signed a contract with KT&G to build a specialized crop cultivation facility for research purposes.

description: Automatic Data Extraction AI agents break where it matters most: when the details are buried in an invoice, a BoL, or a clinical document. Most agents guess. Anyone can build agentic workflows, but AI agents are black boxes that struggle with complex files and processes, like POs, invoices, BoLs and clinical documents. Nanonets agents understand key details in files, work through complex processes and act with transparency, making them the most reliable foundation for building workflows where details matter. Nanonets reduces processing time by 95% by automating messy manual processes and delivering clean data to systems of record like SAP, SFDC and more. name: Neopausia
description: En Neopausia estamos creando una super app para la menopausia que busca empoderar, educar y tratar a las mujeres durante toda su transición menopáusica. Ofrecemos terapia de reemplazo hormonal y no hormonal, prescrita por médicos, respaldada por la ciencia y enviada directamente a tu puerta. El 95% de las mujeres no reciben una terapia eficaz e integral durante su menopausia y son alrededor de 42 millones de mujeres pasando por esta etapa solamente en LATAM. Dado que la mujer en promedio pasa más de un tercio de su vida en la etapa de perimenopausia a postmenopausia, la brecha en la atención es alarmante. Del 100% de mujeres pasan por la menopausia, 80% de ellas experimentan síntomas molestos hasta graves como menstruaciones irregulares, bochornos, dolores musculares y articulares, insomnio, incontinencia, cambios de ánimo, subida de peso, problemas sexuales entre otros (son 34 síntomas en total). Y es más: La mujer no solo sufre de síntomas durante la transición, sino que conforme va pasando el tiempo, también puede afectar su salud a largo plazo con un aumentado riesgo de enfermedades cardiovasculares, Alzheimer/demencia y osteoporosis. Al no tratarse o no tratarse correctamente baja su calidad de vida, salud, longevidad y capacidad productiva. El tratamiento más eficaz y el único aprobado por FDA es el tratamiento hormonal que regula la baja hormonal que ocurre durante esta transición en la mujer. El uso consistente por varios años no solo reduce los síntomas en un 90%, sino también lleva a una reducción de riesgo de mortalidad cardiovascular del 48% y baja la mortalidad general en un 30%. Aunque en Chile 90% de la población podría tomarlo, solo 5% de mujeres usan terapia de reemplazo hormonal. En muchos países de LATAM este % es aún más bajo. ¿Por qué pasa esto? Falta de educación: Muchas mujeres desconocen y confunden los síntomas y sufren sin solución (ej: cambios de ánimo lo tratan con antidepresivos, dolores musculares con kinesiología). Tabúes: Hay muchos tabúes y vergüenza, síntomas y sufrimiento se normalizan. Segmento desatendido: Falta de especialistas y desinformación del personal médico sobre el tema (hubo un estudio, origen de varias ramas más, que decían que las hormonas daban cáncer). ¿Qué hace Neopausia? En Neopausia nuestra misión es eliminar los tabúes y la confusión sobre la menopausia y ayudar a las mujeres a obtener las soluciones que necesitan. Estamos creando una super app para la menopausia que busca empoderar, educar y tratar a las mujeres durante toda su transición. Ofrecemos terapia de reemplazo hormonal, prescrita por médicos, respaldada por la ciencia y enviada directamente a tu puerta. ¿Cómo lo hacemos? Lo que destaca a Neopausia es el acompañamiento transversal en todo el viaje de la mujer. Acompañamos a las mujeres vía Whatsapp para ayudarles a armar su hoja de ruta personal. Este acompañamiento para volverse escalable, requiere de habilitadores tecnológicos: automatización, personalización de mensajes, manejo de BBDD, integración de e-commerce y e-learning. El viaje de la mujer consiste en: Educación: Programas digitales educativas desarrollados con expertas de salud femenina (Más de 200 mujeres ya participaron en nuestro piloto “Menopausia sin Misterios” que creamos junto a 6 expertas de salud femenina) Atención: Hacemos el match entre mujeres y especialistas.Creamos una red de especialistas aprobados por Neopausia - con enfoque de género, conocimiento y experiencia en el tratamiento de menopausia y mirada integral. Tratamiento: Entregamos el tratamiento hormonal recetado por médicos a la puerta de casa de nuestras pacientes, mes a mes para asegurar su uso continuado (durante la semana pasada realizamos un piloto de este paso y ya pudimos vender más de 200.000 CLP en tratamiento hormonal en conjunto con nuestra farmacia partner que nos permite llegar a precios hasta un 40-50% más bajo que las grandes cadenas). Fuentes: Menopause—Biology, consequences, supportive care, and therapeutic options - Susan R. name: Nessie
description: The shared context layer for recursive companies - your work, your… Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates. Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time. Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it. Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops. Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac. Nessie is the layer that gives them, and the humans steering them, a shared memory. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it. Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers, now a team of three in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more. https://nessielabs.com

name: Neurophos
description: Neurophos addresses the growing demand for computational power in AI by pioneering a revolutionary Optical Processing Unit (OPU) using metamaterials, silicon photonics, and analog computing. The OPU’s Compute-In-Memory (CIM) architecture integrates memory and processing into a single unit, reflecting a design mimicking the brain’s efficiency, enabling rapid, energy-efficient processing directly within the memory array. This delivers unprecedented gains in processing speed, energy efficiency, and computational density. Simulations showed that their existing optical ‘transistors’—which are already 10,000× smaller than traditional ones— enable a chip delivering over 1 ExaOPS (one million TOPS), equivalent to a thousand GPUs. This is achievable using current technology, with no need for further miniaturisation or next-gen nodes.
description_alternates: Neurophos is developing optical AI inference accelerators that use light to perform the core matrix operations behind large language models. The company is targeting two orders of magnitude improvements in speed and power efficiency over today’s GPUs, making AI cheaper and relieving the growing power bottleneck limiting AI datacenter growth.
Neurophos develops OPUs (optical processing units) that are 100x faster and 100x more energy efficient that current GPUs. The company is based in Austin, Texas.

An AI company building cutting-edge technology, powered by optical metasurfaces and silicon photonics to introduce a new era of ultra-fast, high-density AI inference designed to bring AI compute to the speed of light and outstrip the capabilities of traditional silicon photonics.

name: Neurowyzr
description: Neurowyzr is a HealthTech company that specializes in developing state-of-the-art technologies to screen, diagnose, treat, and monitor early brain decline. The company is developing solutions to address existing gaps in neurology and brain health and prevent serious brain conditions such as dementia, stroke, and other mental health issues. According to estimates, over 50 million people were suffering from dementia in 2020. It’s a number that’s expected to grow to 152 million by 2050. Currently, one in six people globally have a mental health problem. The lifetime risk of stroke has also increased by 50% over the last 20 years and now affects one in four people. Neurowyzr’s products are designed to address these issues which will have a serious impact on families and societies. The company’s first product is an assessment tool called Digital Brain Function Screen (DBFS). The tool, which uses games and puzzles, significantly reduces the time and cost of traditional cognitive testing. DBFS then produces a medical report within a minute of the test’s completion. This report can be used for clinical discussion and does not require a specialist’s attention. DBFS’ low cost and accessibility has allowed it to be quickly deployed across screening centers, GP clinics and hospitals in Singapore and India. DBFS is registered with the Food and Drug Administration of the United States and Thailand, the Therapeutic Goods Administration of Australia, and Singapore’s Health Sciences Authority
description_alternates: Neurowyzr is a deep neuroscience and brain capital company that uses the latest discoveries in neuroscience to optimize brain performance, brain health, and brain longevity. Neurowyzr has supported leading organisations in Asia in growing their brain capital to build stronger, more resilient, and innovative teams.

name: Neutrolis
description: Neutrolis is developing first-in-class therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases by targeting Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETs), a fundamental arm of the innate immune system which plays an important role in chronic and acute diseases. Neutrolis employs the exDNASE platform, based on naturally occurring enzymes that degrade the extracellular chromatin that form NETs, and powers the creation of natural and engineered enzyme analogs that are capable of treating several acute and chronic unmet medical needs. The lead candidate NTR-441 is an enhanced analog of DNASE1L3, an enzyme produced by immune cells that degrades NETs into biologically inactive fragments to attenuate a severe immune response. The company’s pipeline includes NTR-441, systemically active engineered DNASE1L3, and NTR-452, locally active engineered DNASE1L3, that effectively removes NETs and halt their pathologic effects.

name: Newscatcher
description: Turning the web into a structured database of real world events. CatchAll by NewsCatcher is a recall-first web search API built for queries where the results are spread across hundreds or thousands of pages on the web. Instead of returning the top ranked links like traditional search engines, CatchAll retrieves a large candidate set from the web, validates which pages actually match the query, and extracts structured records of real-world events. Developers and data teams use CatchAll to answer “long-list” questions such as tracking regulatory actions, funding rounds, product launches, corporate expansions, or cybersecurity incidents. The output is not just links but clean, deduplicated datasets that can power AI agents, monitoring systems, analytics pipelines, and market intelligence workflows. CatchAll runs on the data infrastructure developed by NewsCatcher, which continuously indexes millions of articles and public web pages across a global network of sources.
description_alternates: NewsCatcher provides a comprehensive News API for accessing global news data, enabling advanced insights and tailored solutions for business intelligence and media monitoring.

description: Newtrace is a ClimateTech startup that manufactures innovative electrolyzers to produce green hydrogen efficiently and affordably. It aims to tackle climate change by enabling wide-scale adoption of green hydrogen, and by being at the forefront of India’s clean energy transition. The demand for hydrogen was 90 million tonnes in 2020, and its use resulted in over 900 million tonnes of CO2 emissions in the same year. By using green hydrogen instead of fossil fuel-based hydrogen, companies can significantly cut back on their CO2 emissions. This is because the production of green hydrogen relies on renewable energy sources such as solar or wind power. Electrolyzers are key to the production of green hydrogen as they use electricity or renewable energy to split water into hydrogen and oxygen. The hydrogen gas is then collected and used for industrial applications. Newtrace’s proprietary, patent-pending electrolyzer technology is designed to obtain ultrapure hydrogen, with up to 60% reduction in overall production costs. Green hydrogen lends itself to diverse use cases; including the possibility of replacing all fossil-based hydrogen with it in refineries and the fertilizer industry, powering fuel cells in medium to heavy-duty land transport, as well as using it as electrofuel (or e-fuel) in the aviation and shipping industries. Since green hydrogen doesn’t emit polluting gasses, it can significantly help reduce our carbon footprint. Headquartered in Bengaluru, Newtrace was founded

name: Nitricity
description: Nitricity is electrifying organic fertilizer production with a world-first, plant-based alternative that’s transforming agriculture. The US-based company has developed Ash Tea , a liquid organic nitrogen fertilizer made from recycled almond shells, air, water, and renewable energy. Fully vegan, pathogen-free, and cost-competitive, Ash Tea is already sold out for years to come, with farmers lining up to secure supply. With its first commercial-scale facility breaking ground in Delhi, California, Nitricity is scaling globally to meet surging demand from organic growers in the US and Europe. Why we invested in Nitricity The climate case: Conventional fertilizers made through the Haber-Bosch process are responsible for ~2% of global GHG emissions, while also degrading soils, polluting waterways, and driving biodiversity loss. Worse, up to 70% of nitrogen applied is lost to the environment 1 . Nitricity’s organic, circular alternative cuts emissions by more than 90% and restores soil health, while replacing animal-based fertilizers with a cleaner, safer option. By producing nitrogen fertilizer from agricultural waste and renewable energy, Nitricity directly addresses one of agriculture’s most urgent decarbonisation challenges. The business case: Nitricity is addressing the $150B global fertilizer market, starting with a beachhead in organic nitrogen fertilizer for high-value crops, a segment worth over $11B on its own 2 . Farmers are eager for better, affordable solutions, and Nitricity delivers. Its product flows seamlessly through irrigation systems, avoids clogging, and enables more efficient nitrogen use, cutting input costs. With over $150m already in its sales pipeline and binding offtake agreements stretching through 2028, Nitricity is scaling from proven demand, not speculative adoption. The company’s Series B raise, closed in the third quarter of 2025, will accelerate US expansion, advance R&D, and build the European customer pipeline and partnerships in preparation for international growth. The team: Founded in 2018 by Stanford graduates Dr. Nicolas Pinkowski (CEO), Dr. Joshua McEnaney (President & CTO), and Dr. Jay Schwalbe (CSO), Nitricity began with a solar-powered experiment on a lemon tree. Today, the founders lead a 38-person team with deep scientific expertise, a clear commercial track record, and a bold vision for circular, plant-based fertilizer production. Their entrepreneurial grit, coupled with strategic backing from leading climate and agri-tech investors, positions Nitricity as a future global leader in sustainable fertilizer. They give a travel subsidy of $20 to very poor rural laborers so they can send a family member to a nearby city to find a job during the period between planting and harvesting. name: Notebook Labs
description: Decentralized, anonymous, and accountable identity on Web3. Notebook solves the Web3 identity problem by using Zero-Knowledge to provide both anonymous proof-of-humanity and credential aggregation. Notebook initially verifies users’ identifying information to ensure that each person has just a single Notebook. Neither Notebook, nor any other company knows the link between a user’s personal information and their Notebook. Once a user’s Notebook account is created they can begin proving their humanity and aggregating their credentials across wallets. Notebook can be used to increase the safety of DeFi, governance, and airdrops. With Notebook, creators and communities can run Sybil-resistant airdrops, DAOs can verify the humanity and aggregate the credentials of participants, and lending protocols can build credit scoring systems to offer lower-collateralized loans.
team: Nathaniel Masfen-Yan, Solal Afota, Dhruv Mangtani

name: Notpla
description: S ingle-use plastics are destroying our ocean and land ecosystems, with 8 million metric tons of plastic added to the ocean every year (Source: NOAA). At the same time, more microplastics are being absorbed into the food chain with harmful health outcomes. Plastic is also very carbon intensive to produce, emitting GHGs at every step in the production and consumption cycle, from cradle to grave. It’s time to move away from plastic and particularly single-use plastics, in our food system and beyond. The challenge to-date has been the performance, in functionality and price, of alternatives, and supportive regulatory frameworks to incentivise transition. Europe had been a leader in supporting this transition. With its team of material scientists, mechanical engineers and designers, Notpla has created a seaweed-based packaging material which can replace single-use plastics in a variety of formats. Created from brown seaweed, the material is biodegradable, renewable, microplastics-free and even edible. Brown seaweed itself can grow up to 1m per day, does not compete with food crops for resources, does not rely on fresh water or fertilizer to grow, actively contributes to de-acidifying the oceans and naturally captures CO2. Notpla’s material is highly functional and can be used for sauce sachets, liners for disposable takeaway food boxes, and films to replace flexible plastic bags. The company develops both the materials and the machinery to manufacture these items at scale. With the positive impacts generated during both the production and disposal of its products, Notpla aligns with Astanor’s vision for unpolluted, naturally sustainable ocean ecosystems.
description_alternates: Next-generation packaging that disappears
